title: console: a report the user cannot read shows the raw server refusal ("Analytics query refused … (server said: [Analytics] Access denied …)") instead of the no-access state dashboard widgets show
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, reproduced in a browser.
`reach:` the console report page, as a user without read access to the report's dataset object.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01BCDqr1DqnQjEh5jA9gGkUG`) from objectstack-ai/hotcrm's v18 test pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 10). ⛔ Not a claim. File-at-destination, for triage.
Reader: the objectui triage seat.
Dedupe: semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, "report page shows raw analytics query refused server said access denied instead of no-access state, 403 rendering" → 5 hits, all closed. Nearest: #12112 (a dashboard's direct URL 403, the objectstack#22611 ruling-A half) and #11195 / #3046 (other 403 surfaces). None is the report renderer.

## What happens (`@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0, the HotCRM app, fresh database)

As `service.agent` (no read on `crm_opportunity`), open Insights → Pipeline Coverage (`/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/report/pipeline_coverage_by_quarter`).
- **Network:** `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` answers **403**.
- **The page shows a red error box** with this exact text: "Analytics query refused: this user may not read the data behind dataset "opportunity_metrics". (server said: [Analytics] Access denied: reading "crm_opportunity" is not permitted for this user.)"
- **A dashboard widget refused the same way** renders the friendly state: "You don't have access / You don't have permission to view the data behind this widget".

Screenshot: [10-report-raw-analytics-refusal-text.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/0425ebf252b89615ba53006bee343bd3205d58d5/qa/2026-10-13-v18-pass/10-report-raw-analytics-refusal-text.png).

## Ask

The report renderer maps an analytics 403 to the same no-access state that dashboard widgets use, with no raw server text, so a permission wall reads as "you don't have access" and never as an error.

The app half (should this persona see the entry at all) is objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2060 item 5, which can use the nav item's `requiresObject` gate.
